author: Tobias Ellinghaus
name: delete_unused_tags
description: Automatically deletes all tags that are not attached to any images each time darktable restarts.
description-extensive: This simple add-on cleans up your keyword list by removing any tags that aren't attached to a single photo. It runs automatically every time you start darktable, so unused labels never pile up. It's a set-and-forget way to keep your tag list clutter-free.
